timing: Prospective stopping-rule amendment after inspection of validation curves from eight incomplete-budget v1 pilot runs, before any reserved test or path labels are opened. All 15 official model-seed runs start anew under this same amendment; pilot checkpoints are not reused.
unchanged: Data split, selected features, model architectures, seeds, objective, initialization, Adam learning rates and ReduceLROnPlateau parameters, LBFGS settings per call, validation metric and best-checkpoint selection remain exactly as in v1.

adam.rule: After at least 2600 Adam steps, stop at a validation check only when the running best validation stress score has failed to improve cumulatively by at least 0.1% over 80 validation checks AND ReduceLROnPlateau has reached its frozen minimum learning rate. Otherwise stop at the 7800-step safety cap and label the phase budget-limited. The scheduler is stepped after every validation check, including the initial check.

lbfgs.rule: Start from the best Adam checkpoint. After at least 40 outer calls, stop when the running best validation stress score has failed to improve cumulatively by at least 0.1% over 20 outer calls. Otherwise stop at the 120-call safety cap and label the phase budget-limited. Strong-Wolfe line search remains the within-call step-size rule; no LBFGS learning-rate scheduler is added.

checkpoint_rule: The final checkpoint is still the strict minimum validation stress score over initialization, Adam and LBFGS. A plateau stop is a finite-run operational criterion, not proof of convergence or constitutive accuracy.
evaluation_gate: Freeze and hash all 15 v2 final checkpoints and reports before opening reserved test or path labels. Report plateau versus safety-cap stops, achieved Adam learning rates, outer calls, internal LBFGS iterations and function evaluations for every run.
